title: HELIX Bridge (Reverse): HELIX AcademicPeriod → Banner SaaS (Ethos)
api_method: Ethos Integration API (often read-only) / Banner configuration
write_model: GET for correlation is universally available; POST/PUT support varies. Prefer establishing terms via Banner configuration and using Ethos only to resolve GUIDs for downstream writes.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Reference parent term GUID for subterms.
attribute_mappings.notes: FLAG: parent linkage field name varies by Ethos version.

constraints: academic-periods are reference data; typically configured in Banner and often read-only via Ethos on many tenants.
Writing periods may require Banner-side setup (STVTERM/SOBPTRM) rather than an Ethos POST — verify tenant capability. Treat as configuration, not routine write-back.
